symptom: After a cloud workspace stopped and resumed, an idle terminal showed '[process exited with code 0] — press any key to restart' and 'Workspace resumed — new shell' even though no command had run.
rule: A workspace stop is not a user-visible shell exit. Start a clean shell when nothing ran; when commands ran, keep their output and say once that a new shell started, before its prompt, and never when another client already resumed the live shell.
